verdict.rationale: Supabase's docs consistently describe a real Postgres database. They cover connecting to Postgres directly, built-in Postgres full-text search functions and Postgres RLS. They also document real extensions: pgvector, pgmq for Queues, pg_graphql, and Cron as a Postgres module. Migration guides from Amazon RDS, Neon and other Postgres hosts point the same way. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that this is unmodified, full-dialect Postgres with version details, a broader extension catalog or a way to install arbitrary extensions, and independent hands-on corroboration of compatibility.
